skills.name: Clinical Finish
skills.text: 40% chance: deal 200% ATK damage, apply [Sprint] to allies for 3 turns (30% chance to dodge enemy skills; targeted skill damage/effects do not trigger).

skills.name: Divine Power
skills.text: All allies' attributes +5% in Road to the Cup.

skills.name: Universal Mastery
skills.text: Assign to any building for Resource Productivity +40%.

skills.name: Ice Dragon's Breath
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Merlin's dragon companion exhales a freezing breath, dealing skill damage equal to 200% of ATK and applying [Shield Break] to allies (40% of skill damage and extra damage dealt by allies ignores the target's shield for 3 turns). If the enemy has a shield, deals 1 instance of extra damage equal to 150% of ATK.

skills.name: Atlas Strength Lv. 1
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Heracles exerts his full strength for a desperate strike, dealing skill damage equal to 200% of ATK. Removes 1 buff from the enemies. If allies have more buffs than enemies, deals 1 extra damage equal to 100% of ATK.

skills.name: Atlas Strength Lv. 2
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Heracles exerts his full strength for a desperate strike, dealing skill damage equal to 210% of ATK. Removes 1 buff from the enemies. If allies have more buffs than enemies, deals 1 extra damage equal to 105% of ATK.

skills.name: Atlas Strength Lv. 3
skills.text: Activates at 10-Star. 40% chance to activate: Heracles exerts his full strength for a desperate strike, dealing skill damage equal to 220% of ATK. Removes 1 buff from the enemies. If allies have more buffs than enemies, deals 1 extra damage.

skills.name: Animal Companion
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Circe commands her animal companion to attack, dealing skill damage equal to 200% of ATK and applying [Curse Kill] to enemies. While this state lasts, if the target's HP falls below 10% after taking damage, they die instantly; revival, death immunity, and similar effects cannot trigger.

skills.name: Excalibur
skills.text: 40% chance: deal 200% ATK, allies' Skill Damage Reduction +20% for 3 turns. Enemies enter [Rend] (before acting, take DoT equal to 75% of allies' ATK for 3 turns).

skills.name: Knight King
skills.text: All ATK damage +6% in any hero battle.

skills.name: Glass Mastery
skills.text: Glass Workshop Resource Productivity +40%.

skills.name: Leviathan's Might
skills.text: 40% chance: deal 200% ATK damage. Inflicts [Rend] (DoT 75% ATK for 3 turns). Allies heal 50% of total DoT taken by enemies.

skills.name: Talent of Guile
skills.text: Gain +4% points in Delve into Atlantis.

skills.name: Plantation Mastery
skills.text: Plantation Resource Productivity +44%.

artifact.name: Aeolus's Bag of Winds
artifact.text: For 3 turns after casting a skill, Odysseus heals allies for 50% of the damage dealt by enemies at the end of their action.

skills.name: Straight Punch
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Bjorn targets the enemy's weak point and strikes with his iron fist, dealing skill damage equal to 200% of ATK. Increases allied Crit DMG by 20% for 3 turns. This attack has a 50% chance to trigger [Critical Hit], increasing this instance of damage by 50%. If the target has a shield, this attack is guaranteed to trigger [Critical Hit].

skills.name: Viking Raid
skills.text: 40% chance: deal 200% ATK damage, reduce enemies' skill damage bonus by 20% for 2 turns, 50% chance to apply [Plunder] (for 3 turns, any buff gained by target transfers to allies while retaining its status).

skills.name: Valhalla Summon
skills.text: Ally damage dealt +12% in Trials of Odin.

skills.name: Brewing Mastery
skills.text: Brewery Resource Productivity +40%.

skills.name: Arctic Charge Lv. 1
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Lagertha orders her companions to charge the enemy, dealing skill damage equal to 200% of ATK. This action has a 50% chance to trigger a [Critical Hit] (+50% DMG). At the end of this action, allies recover HP equal to 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Arctic Charge Lv. 2
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Lagertha orders her companions to charge the enemy, dealing skill damage equal to 210% of ATK. This action has a 53% chance to trigger a [Critical Hit] (+50% DMG). At the end of this action, allies recover HP equal to 53% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Arctic Charge Lv. 3
skills.text: Activates at 10-Star. 40% chance to activate: Lagertha orders her companions to charge the enemy, dealing skill damage equal to 220% of ATK.

skills.name: Master of Three Seas
skills.text: 40% chance: deal 200% ATK, heal allies for 50% of damage dealt, 50% chance for [Barrier] (Immune to all damage for 1 turn).

skills.name: Uncrowned One
skills.text: All Heroes Damage Reduction +8%.

skills.name: Creation Mastery
skills.text: Art Workshop Resource Productivity +52%.

artifact.name: Eagle Scepter
artifact.text: After Pompey casts a skill, if his HP is above 50%, increases allies' skill damage bonus by 20% for 3 turns. If his HP is 50% or below, recovers HP equal to 10% of allies' Max HP.

skills.name: Oath of the Broken Chain
skills.text: 40% chance: deal 200% ATK, 50% chance to trigger [Critical Hit] (+50% DMG). If triggered, 30% chance to apply [Heal Block] (healed HP cannot exceed 1) for 2 turns.

skills.name: Warrior's Awakening
skills.text: In Imperial Invasion, Skill Damage Bonus +12%.

skills.name: Leather Mastery
skills.text: Tannery Resource Productivity +44%.

artifact.name: Broken Shackles
artifact.text: Before Spartacus casts a skill, increases allies' skill damage bonus by 15%. For each debuff on enemies, allies' skill damage bonus for that turn is further increased by 15%. Stacks up to 2 times.

skills.name: Cracked Sky Dawn
skills.text: 40% chance: deal 200% ATK damage. Triggers [Pursuit] (extra skill cast) dealing 40% ATK damage; trigger chance reduces by 40% each time it repeats.

skills.name: Conqueror's Will
skills.text: In Dawn of Rome event, soldiers cap +30%.

skills.name: Papermaking Mastery
skills.text: Paper Mill Resource Productivity +44%.

artifact.name: Golden Throne
artifact.text: When Caesar casts a skill, after triggering the 2nd extra ATK, increases allies' skill damage bonus by 10% and extra damage bonus by 50% for 3 turns.

skills.name: Majesty of the Royal Tomb Lv. 2
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Cleopatra proclaims the inviolable majesty of the royal tomb, dealing damage equal to 210% of ATK, and modifies the enemy's next action, replacing it with 1 Normal Attack by allies against them that deals 55% of Normal Attack damage.

skills.name: Soul Chain
skills.text: 40% chance to activate: Morgana conjures magical chains to bind the enemy, dealing skill damage equal to 200% of ATK, with a 50% chance to inflict [Strip] for 2 turns. [Strip]: While this state lasts, all collection skills except exclusive collection cannot trigger.
